diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

null_resource.wait_for_cluster has an explicit depends_on on aws_eks_cluster.this, but this ordering is already established implicitly: the resource's local-exec provisioner references aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint in its environment block (ENDPOINT = aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint), which already makes Terraform create the EKS cluster before this resource. The explicit depends_on entry is a duplicate and can be removed.
